fields.Name: Dropbox OAuth
fields.Description: Read-only access to the More Cheese demo Dropbox (vault/internal). Encrypted with the More Cheese Shared Key: set MORECHEESE_SHARED_KEY (from the More Cheese portal) in MJAPI's environment to use it.

_comments: Read-only access to the More Cheese demo Dropbox. Values are sealed with the More Cheese Shared Key (config/encryption-keys), so every install given that key can read it; see scripts/seal-credential.mjs.
The Skip component registry key the More Cheese dashboards load their components with: MJ looks for a credential named "Component Registry: <registry name>" when no REGISTRY_API_KEY_SKIP is set.
A demo key that can read only the More Cheese components, sealed with the More Cheese Shared Key; see scripts/seal-credential.mjs.

fields.Name: Component Registry: Skip
fields.Description: Read-only Skip registry key for the More Cheese dashboards' components. Encrypted with the More Cheese Shared Key: set MORECHEESE_SHARED_KEY (from the More Cheese portal) in MJAPI's environment to use it. An install with its own REGISTRY_API_KEY_SKIP (or a Skip API key, which the Skip client uses for the registry) uses that instead.
